Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated floorplan v3 + crate manifest request

Hi Priyom,

Attached is the revised hall floorplan (v3) — we've nudged the main entrance canopy 8ft to the left to improve sightlines from the main corridor. Can you confirm that the relocated demo island still meets Redwood's visibility requirements and that the curated sample kit manifest (requested below) matches what you'll be shipping?

What we need from Redwood by EOD Wed:
- Formal sign-off on the v3 floorplan (PDF) so we can lock graphics permits
- Final crate manifest (items, qty, weight per crate) for freight booking
- Any special crate-label wording you want on arrival (e.g., contact name/phone)

I've attached: EdgeCon_floorplan_v3.pdf for your review.

Also looping Rob from Expo Logistics to confirm dock windows and pickup timings.

Thanks — excited to get this locked.

Best,

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@edgecon.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated floorplan v3 + crate manifest request

Thanks Alyssa — quick read and a few clarifying points below.

1) Sightlines: moving the canopy 8ft left improves approach visibility from the main corridor; that matches our priority. Confirming the demo island footprint remains the same (10x10). We still have 6ft clearance on the demo counter side per ADA — please confirm there is no new hardscape in that 6ft band.

2) Crate manifest: attaching our working manifest (crate_manifest_EdgeCon_v1.xlsx). It lists 3 crates:
   - CRATE A: demo pedestal + monitors + HDMI kit (420 lbs)
   - CRATE B: printed collateral + swag + sample kits (220 lbs)
   - CRATE C: modular backwall + hardware + tools (580 lbs)

Please confirm any weight caps for your freight partner (we can repartition if dock lift is limited). Also let me know the exact label we should use on crates — we usually use: "Redwood Inference / EDGECON Booth C12 / Arrival Contact: Priyom Das +1-650-555-7099". Happy to follow your preferred format.

3) Signage proofs: Marissa — FYI ClearSign sent proofs (signage_proofs_ClearSign_v2.pdf). Can you take a quick look and flag any color/brand issues? We want signage to be production-ready by Thursday to hit vendor deadlines.

4) Timeline ask: if we can sign v3 and final manifest by EOD Wed (10/6), we'll lock print and freight. If any of you need an internal PO or procurement note, ping Karthik.

Next steps: Alyssa or Rob, confirm dock window and any drayage weight limit; Marissa, please confirm signage within 24 hours so we can commit to ClearSign.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
(650) 555-7099

Attachment: crate_manifest_EdgeCon_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 46KB)

From: Rob Levin <rob@expo-logistics.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@edgecon.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: logistics@expo-logistics.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated floorplan v3 + crate manifest request

Hi all — copying logistics team. Quick notes from the freight side:  

- Dock: Hall B dock has a 2,200 lb lift limit per pallet jack; we can accept a single 700 lb crate without issue. If any crate exceeds 1,000 lb we recommend splitting for safe handling.
- Pickup window: Recommended pickup from Redwood's warehouse 10/20-10/21 for arrival on 10/24 (event load-in 10/25). Please confirm preferred pickup date.
- Crate labels: please use this exact format, it speeds scanning at our yard: 
   [Company] | [Booth] | [Event] | [Arrival Contact Name] | [Arrival Phone]
   e.g., Redwood Inference | C12 | EdgeCon2027 | Priyom Das | +1-650-555-7099

- Pro tip: include crate weight on the outside lower-right corner in lbs.

Attached is an updated drayage note template — I'll populate once you confirm final weights.

Rob Levin
Operations Lead | Expo Logistics
rob@expo-logistics.com
Attachment: expo_drayage_template.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Alyssa Park <alyssa@edgecon.com>, prints@clearsign.co
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated floorplan v3 + crate manifest request

All — reviewing now and happy to sign v3. A few final confirmations before I click approve with ClearSign:

- Marissa: signage review notes (quick): replace the secondary CTA font with Redwood Grotesk SemiBold (attached comment in proofs), reduce logo clearspace by 10% on the demo counter banner so the copy reads better from 8ft.
- Karthik: estimated print + install cost from ClearSign is $5,400 (sign plus rigging). Can you confirm the PO or approve up to $6k to cover any last-minute scope? If you'd like, I can split signage vs install on the PO.
- Priyom/Tessa: we will use Rob's label format. Priyom — please confirm pickup date (10/20 or 10/21) and I'll finalize crate weight rebalancing if needed.

If we get Karthik's OK and Priyom's pickup date by EOD tomorrow, I will sign the floorplan PDF (EdgeCon_floorplan_v3.pdf) and push signage to print.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Producer | Redwood Inference
